state:
**Goal `ext-compiler`. Stage 3 (the call) is done; Stage 4 (qualifiers) is next and has nothing written.** Stages 1 to 3 are on disk. The design is ADR 0246 § 8 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*. This goal has no record slot.

`nvs run` and `nvs serve` both call an extension end to end. Codegen emits `InstKind::ExtensionCall` as a variadic call of `nvs_runtime::extension::nvs_extension_call`. `nvs-cli`'s `extensions::Calls` hosts it over one `nvs_ext::call::Request`, and dropping a `Calls` ends the request (`crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs` module doc).

In `nvs serve` every worker installs `extensions::Served`, which keeps one `Calls` per request in `nvs_runtime::TreeState::extensions`, dropped with the request tree. Serve's compiler types a program against the live set's manifests (`extensions::live_manifests`). Pinned by `crates/nvs-cli/tests/live_config.rs` `a_served_request_calls_a_configured_extension`.

The driver's earliest red check is Stage 4's `nvs-types-an-extension-sink-refuses-with-the-core-code`, with the rest of Stage 4, then Stages 5 and 6.

items.text: **A manifest declares `tainted` and `secret`, and a declaration that loosens does not load**: a param may be a `sink` (refuses `tainted`), a return may be a `source` (is `tainted`); a `secret` return or an unknown qualifier refuses the load (`crates/nvs-ext/src/manifest.rs:145`, `crates/nvs-ext/src/manifest.rs:182`). `rule:security/extension-manifest-only-tightens`. Check `nvs-ext-a-manifest-cannot-loosen-a-qualifier`.

**The declarations reach the `MethodSig` fields a `Core` member's carry**, so `admits_tainted_argument` and `tainted_result` read them with no extension branch, and a `secret` argument is refused with the code a `Core` boundary gives (`crates/nvs-types/src/ext_lib.rs:225`, `crates/nvs-types/src/signatures.rs:58`). `rule:packaging/extension-calls-are-statically-typed`. Check `nvs-types-an-extension-sink-refuses-with-the-core-code`.

**The four conformance cases** of check `an-extension-call-keeps-every-qualifier-rule`; the fixture gains the sink and source methods it needs (`tests/conformance/ext/fixtures/ledger/manifest.json:56`, held to its text by `crates/nvs-ext/tests/fixtures.rs`).

backlog: A worker thread that does not run the serve loop (a queue crew, an off-core member) installs no `Served`, so an extension call there finds no host: `crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs` module doc.
`spawn script` inside `nvs run` compiles through `script::Compiler`, which reads the live set, and `nvs run` installs none: the child is typed with no extensions.
Stage 5 (the source section) and Stage 6 (`nvs check`, `nvs test`, the language server): the goal file.
